annotations.title: Find songs to play with the chords you know

description: Finds songs a guitarist can play with the chords they already know, from Fretwork's free library of 87 public-domain folk, gospel, blues, campfire and Christmas songs. Each song has chords, key, time signature, level and a free play-along page. Can also list songs that need just one or two new chords.

chords_known.description: Chords the player can already play, e.g. "G C D Em".

max_new_chords.description: Also include songs needing up to this many extra chords (default 0).
